description: NEW — Create a reusable voice character for Gemini Omni video generation. Returns kieAudioId for use in generate_video audio_ids.

audio_id.description: Preset base voice (30 options). The created voice inherits this preset and is customized by voice_description.

estimate_only.description: Return the estimated credit cost WITHOUT submitting anything. Use before expensive runs (video, 4K, 1080p upgrades, layer splits).

example_dialogue.description: Sample dialogue (max 120 chars), e.g. "Hello, I am Adam"

max_credits.description: Refuse to submit if the estimated cost exceeds this many credits (overrides KIE_MAX_CREDITS_PER_CALL). Estimates come from published rates; kie bills the actual amount.

voice_description.description: Detailed voice characteristics: timbre, style, rate, emotion (max 20000 chars)

name: create_omni_voice
